name: fmage
description: Generate and edit images through configurable OpenAI-compatible providers, and apply a fixed local image-regression pipeline with Codex-guided workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Provider image tools plus local image regression.
interface.longDescription: Adds first-class image generation and editing tools with prompts revised by the active Codex model, switchable local provider configuration, and a fixed local Pillow workflow for proportional 1K downscaling, Gaussian blur, and monochrome luminance noise. API keys remain outside the shareable plugin directory.
defaultPrompt: Edit this reference image with Fmage.
Locally regress this image with the fixed Fmage pipeline.
